query: SELECT jsonb_build_object('productId',product_id,'sourceAuthor',author,'rating',rating,'title',title,'text',content,'verifiedPurchase',verified,'sourceDigest',source_import->>'recordDigest','createdAt',to_char(created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"')) AS "value!" FROM product_reviews WHERE tenant=$1 AND id=$2
